title: DESCRIPTION
source:
*EXAMINATION WORKS*

* Distributed the Q/A papers for the Mid-Term Examination.

* Performed Floor Duty during the Mid-Term Examination.

* Collected the answer copies after the Mid-Term Examination.

* Given the Mid Term answer bundle to few teachers for review.

* Arranged the CBSE marksheets roll-number-wise.

*OTHER WORKS*

* Dispersal Duty.

* Prepared the biometric attendance records of Teaching, Non-Teaching, Admin, Transport, Security Guard, and 4th Grade employees as instructed by the Principal Sir.

* Updated the Homework Follow-up Google Sheet as instructed by the Principal Sir.

* Updated the Google sheet to reflect the submission status of the Mid Term bundle.
